title: Background Processing
description: Durable outbox state and independent relay/consumer attempts.

options.content: One event can create multiple deliveries. Each delivery can have multiple attempts across retries and replay. Receipt-window gauges describe durable progress. Attempt counters describe process observations. Worker traces are separate roots linked to original context. Tempo and Loki retain about three days. Worker logs stay local.

panels.title: Unfinished delivery depth
panels.description: Sum of queued, in-flight, retry-delayed and recovery-due delivery states for each consumer. Shared snapshots are deduplicated before aggregation.

targets.expr: sum by (consumer) (max by (consumer, state) (restaurantos_worker_deliveries{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",state=~"queued|in_flight|retry_delayed|recovery_due"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45))

panels.title: Unfinished deliveries by state
panels.description: Database-derived counts. In-flight includes active leases. Recovery due includes expired or missing processing leases. Redis stream length is independent.

targets.expr: max by (consumer, state) (restaurantos_worker_deliveries{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",state=~"queued|in_flight|retry_delayed|recovery_due"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45)

panels.title: Oldest unfinished delivery
panels.description: Database-clock age since creation across unfinished states. Zero for empty states. If all workers stop, worker snapshot panels go unavailable. Business Activity still shows analytics-delivery age while its independent API sampler runs.

targets.expr: max by (consumer) (max by (consumer, state) (restaurantos_worker_oldest_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",state=~"queued|in_flight|retry_delayed|recovery_due"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45))

panels.title: Oldest delivery age by unfinished state
panels.description: Snapshot age in each unfinished state. Zero means the state was empty at collection.

targets.expr: max by (consumer, state) (restaurantos_worker_oldest_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",state=~"queued|in_flight|retry_delayed|recovery_due"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45)

panels.title: Terminal delivery failures
panels.description: Durable terminal deliveries awaiting operator review. Excluded from unfinished depth.

targets.expr: max by (consumer) (restaurantos_worker_deliveries{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",state="terminal"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45)

panels.title: Oldest terminal delivery age
panels.description: Age since creation of the oldest terminal delivery, not time since failure. Zero for empty terminal state.

targets.expr: max by (consumer) (restaurantos_worker_oldest_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",state="terminal"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45)

panels.title: Recent durable receipts
panels.description: Receipts recorded in the preceding five minutes, including processed and skipped outcomes. Deduplicated delivery and replay cannot add another receipt for an already receipted effect.

targets.expr: max by (consumer) (restaurantos_worker_receipts_window{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45)

panels.title: Recent receipt throughput
panels.description: Approximate durable receipt throughput using the five-minute snapshot count divided by 300. It is a gauge.

targets.expr: (max by (consumer) (restaurantos_worker_receipts_window{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45)) / 300

panels.title: Publication attempts by outcome
panels.description: One-minute rate per original counter series before aggregation. Process restarts reset counters. A series first appears after an observation, and a gap means no usable samples. Published requires Redis publication and fenced database observation.

targets.expr: sum by (consumer, outcome) ((rate(restaurantos_worker_operations_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",operation="publish"}[1m]) and restaurantos_worker_operations_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",operation="publish"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))

panels.title: Consumer attempts by outcome
panels.description: One-minute rate per original counter series before aggregation. Process restarts reset counters. A series first appears after an observation, and a gap means no usable samples. A committed attempt can process or skip a receipt. It does not count unique business events.

targets.expr: sum by (consumer, outcome) ((rate(restaurantos_worker_operations_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",operation="consumer"}[1m]) and restaurantos_worker_operations_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",operation="consumer"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))

panels.title: Scheduled retries and failed attempts
panels.description: Retry settlements and terminal-failure settlements are separate observed attempt outcomes. See terminal depth for the current durable count.

targets.expr: sum by (consumer, outcome) ((rate(restaurantos_worker_operations_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",operation="consumer",outcome=~"consumer_retry_scheduled|consumer_failed"}[1m]) and restaurantos_worker_operations_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker",operation="consumer",outcome=~"consumer_retry_scheduled|consumer_failed"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))

panels.title: Worker attempt duration
panels.description: Bucket estimates include execution and settlement. They exclude time waiting in the durable backlog.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, operation) ((rate(restaurantos_worker_duration_seconds_bucket{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}[1m]) and restaurantos_worker_duration_seconds_bucket{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation) ((rate(restaurantos_worker_duration_seconds_bucket{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}[1m]) and restaurantos_worker_duration_seconds_bucket{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, operation) ((rate(restaurantos_worker_duration_seconds_bucket{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}[1m]) and restaurantos_worker_duration_seconds_bucket{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)))

panels.title: Routing checks without a new claim
panels.description: Duplicate, busy, delayed and other routing outcomes do not represent new effects or necessarily have attempt traces. Use the worker's local JSON diagnostics.

targets.expr: sum by (consumer, outcome) ((rate(restaurantos_worker_routes_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}[1m]) and restaurantos_worker_routes_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))

panels.title: Worker snapshot collection failures
panels.description: Failed or timed-out collection. Does not advance the source timestamp. Process metrics require a configured worker slot.

targets.expr: sum by (worker_slot) ((rate(restaurantos_worker_collection_failures_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}[1m]) and restaurantos_worker_collection_failures_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))

panels.title: Worker snapshot source age
panels.description: Worker durable panels require a nonfuture collection timestamp under 45 seconds old. Series can disappear earlier on Collector expiry. This check is an observation freshness budget.

panels.title: Worker snapshot status
panels.description: Unavailable after Collector expiry, before the first successful read or when there is no export.

targets.expr: (0 * ((time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < 45) + 1) or (0 * (time() - max (restaurantos_worker_collected_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-worker"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))))
